```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
begin
  result = LiterLlm.image_generate(LiterLlm::CreateImageRequest.new(model: 'dall-e-3', n: 1, prompt: '', size: '1024x1024'))
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
